column1: # The weekly monitor's sources (spec §5, brief P): what it fetches, how often, and where the next
# edition of a source read by hand is expected. Metadata only: ids, cadences, dates and the points
# fetched; every fetched table lives in the archive (archive/tables/monitor/<source>/), never here.
# `fetcher` names the module in tools/timetables/monitor/fetchers/ (`manual` for a source with no
# working endpoint: PDFs, images, a site that refuses scripted access). `cadence` is weekly, monthly,
# month-start (a page that shows the current month alone: due as soon as a new month has begun in
# Africa/Johannesburg since the source's last complete fetch, so due until that month is captured whole)
# or manual (a fetcher with cadence manual runs only when named with --only); `next_expected` (a date or a
# month, or `-`) is when a source read by hand expects its next edition — the report says "due" once it
# passes; move it on after the edition is in the archive. Every fetched table is checked as the entry
# Automatic follows at its point: a cautious entry's member row beside the table's own entry.
